stem.text: When a small quantity of phospholipid is added to a test-tube of water and then shaken vigorously, an emulsion is formed by small droplets called liposomes.
Which diagram shows the arrangement of phospholipid molecules in a cross-section of a liposome?

A.alt: Ring of phospholipid symbols, each with a circular head and double-line tails, drawn as printed (option A).

B.alt: Ring of phospholipid symbols, each with a circular head and double-line tails, drawn as printed (option B).

C.alt: Ring of phospholipid symbols, each with a circular head and double-line tails, drawn as printed (option C).

D.alt: Ring of phospholipid symbols, each with a circular head and double-line tails, drawn as printed (option D).
